latest.title: Badri Rao
latest.blurb: Badri has spent 26 years helping people move without pain, and his message is simple: your pain is not your age, and it is not something you have to live with. Why his very first patient was sent home before treatment began, how a 65-year-old with a replacement-level knee went on to climb 12 Himalayan peaks, and why the most boring advice in health, drink water, could be what saves your ACL.
